key_insight: Replacing accuracy-based prompt selection with pairwise ranking optimization (Ranking-PE) aligns multimodal prompt search with AUROC, improving clinical ranking quality without extra model calls.
clinical_relevance: For imbalanced diagnostic tasks, this approach is more useful than accuracy because it rewards correctly ranking diseased cases above non-diseased ones, which better matches real clinical screening needs.
method: Swap binary correctness scores for positive-vs-negative pairwise ordering scores.
Use the resulting matrix to drive Pareto dominance, reflection feedback, and final candidate selection.
Optimize prompt evolution directly for AUROC with no surrogate loss and no added model calls.
evidence_signal: Evaluated across three diseases on MIMIC, with gains of +5.8 AUROC points on fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B and +16.2 points on MedGemma-4B versus accuracy-based prompt evolution.
watch_item: Performance still depends on having a strong medical visual backbone, so prompt optimization cannot fully compensate for a weak or non-medical encoder.
paper_title: Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis
